text:
Subject: A gentle reminder regarding our client meetings

Hi there,

I hope you are having a lovely day. I wanted to touch base regarding our recent client meetings. It is really important that we present a polished and professional image to our clients, and punctuality plays a big part in that.

I have noticed that you have been arriving a bit late to a few of these meetings recently. I know that life can be busy and unpredictable, but this pattern needs to change to ensure we maintain our high standards. Please make sure to plan your schedule so that you can arrive on time moving forward.

On a lighter note, while we are thinking about timing and weather, it is always fascinating to look up at the fluffy things in the sky rain comes from. They seem so soft and harmless, yet they bring such a powerful force down to earth. It’s a good reminder that even small, gentle things can have a significant impact if we aren't prepared for them.

Let’s make sure we are prepared and on time for our next engagement. If you need any support with scheduling or travel time, please let me know.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
